about.description: DigiFT is a MAS-licensed digital securities exchange (Recognised Market Operator + Capital Markets Services license) operating out of Singapore, founded in 2021 by Henry Zhang. The platform offers secondary trading and primary issuance of tokenized securities — including tokenized US Treasury funds, structured notes, and corporate bonds — to accredited and institutional investors. DigiFT differentiates from other RWA platforms by holding direct exchange licensing in a Tier-1 jurisdiction (Singapore), enabling on-venue trading with regulatory clarity. Issuers using DigiFT include UBS (tokenized MMF) and Invesco (tokenized money market). Trades settle on-chain in stablecoins or fiat.
about.registryInfo: DigiFT Tech (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based digital securities exchange operator. It holds a Recognised Market Operator (RMO) license and a Capital Markets Services (CMS) license from the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), making it one of the first MAS-regulated on-chain RWA trading venues. Founded 2021 by Henry Zhang (CEO) and the DigiFT team. Backed by Shanghai Pudong Development Bank International, HashKey Capital, and others. UEN: 202109302K. Headquartered in Singapore.

fees.revenueNotes: DigiFT operates as a MAS-licensed exchange. Trading/tokenization fees are charged to issuers and traders rather than as MMF mgmt fees. The 10/10 bps mint/redeem figures are placeholders representing typical exchange-side fees; actual schedule is bespoke per issuer agreement and not publicly disclosed. Underlying products (UBS MMF, Invesco MMF) carry their own mgmt fees separately.
